Description: A fragmentary Hebrew copy of Isaiah from Qumran Cave 4, published in DJD XV (Skehan-Ulrich). Its surviving passages run from Isaiah 2 to Isaiah 14, with a single later fragment from Isaiah 59:15-16.
Significance: A further early witness to the first half of Isaiah, including the vineyard and throne-vision material of Isaiah 2-14; its scattered survival limits what it can prove beyond those passages.
